title: The Autopsy of the Marlowe Estate
author: O. M. Dravenmoor
blurb: Beatrix Halloran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
